high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a mobile application interface displaying a list of categories for games or apps. Below the title, there is a section labeled "All categories," which appears to be a header for the list that follows. The list includes various game genres or categories, each accompanied by an icon representing the genre: Action - Represented by a helicopter icon. Adventure - Represented by a compass icon. Arcade - Represented by a game machine icon
